name: project-capacity
title: Project capacity
description: Show honestly how many slots are left in the coming months: month tiles with filled and open places, and a reserve button.
docs: Pass months (a label, a total and a number taken each, three to six), action, waitlistHref, a title and an optional note. Each month is a tile with a row of dots, filled for a booked place and outlined for an open one, and the same thing in words: 1 of 3 open, or Full. The dots are decoration and hidden from assistive technology, so colour is never the only signal; the numbers come from you, which is what makes the scarcity honest. Full months stay visible and link to the waiting list (the link is named after its month for a screen reader). The button reserves a slot, and becomes Join the waiting list when no month has a place left. Tiles are rows on a narrow section and share the width from 576px, in a column count that follows the number of months, so a lonely tile never wraps to its own row. Up to six places a month sit in one row of dots, more are split into two even rows, and above 24 only the words are shown. labels translates every fixed word.
